title: The Message Concerning Philistia
description: In the year that King Ahaz died, a message came through Isaiah warning Philistia not to rejoice because the rod that struck them was broken. From the root of the serpent would come a viper and a flying seraph-serpent, and smoke from the north would sweep over the land. The firstborn of the poor would find safe pasture, while the root of Philistia would die of famine. The Lord has established Zion, and there his afflicted people will find refuge. [ref:Jes 14:28-32|Isaiah 14:28-32]
